lines.t: Look at the history of men
Same hunger
New crown
Borrow breath
Talking like they own the ground
You built what?
What? A throne? On his earth?
For work, still can't command one breath from the dirt
Dark in the palace, a whisper, a deal
Trade at the truth for the right to make kneel
Caught in ascension, look close at the chain
A slave in the crown, is a slave of the same
Hands on the dart, his boots on the weak
Their names are self-mighty when the wounded can't speak
Hear that? Not power, but coward with guards
You clock of the village, you get a mixed heart
Who laid the earth?
Not you
Who holds your breath?
Not you
Who can your battlements keep from the throat?
Nobody!
You don't own what you stand on
Yahushua, Yahuwah, sovereign over all Kings become dust and their kingdoms fall
Yahushua, Yahuwah, none can take your throne All that breathes is borrowed, all the glory yours alone
Big crown, small box, name card, time style Stone cracks, gold rust, king of the world, king of the dust
Up in the hills hear the families grieving Down in the courts hear the tyrants scheming
Wanted their daughters, wanted their land Wanted the world in the palm of her hand
Raised up sons to inherit the violence Taught them that mercy was weakness and silence
Men are renowned with the buzz still wet
All that fame and the judge hadn't spoken yet
That number was built while the whole crowd sneered
Hammer kept time as the dark drew near
They hit the punchlines, he had his past
Face kept moving while the mouths ran fast
Where's your flood?
Where's your rain?
Still swinging that hammer, not playing your game
The wounded were seen, the violence waved
The skies turned black, the laughter frayed
The door is shut
Deep breaks!
Sky tears!
Where's that crown?
Where's that sneer?
Stone thrown
Under the swell
Well, all that boasting, how'd that hold up?
Not one wall could negotiate, not one king could command it
Wait, names washed out of the monument's face
One ark carried by mercy and grace
No laughter for the children, no anthem for their pain
Let the proud man's glory perish, let us never thirst for blood again
Fresh earth, fresh start, same old appetite
Should not get this busy putting pride in the skyline
Nimrod rises, the crowd wants a name
New brick suit on the same old shame
Sack it, pack it, build to the sky
Make us a name that will never die
You need baked mud just to reach that height
Now you're challenging the maker of light
Who to make heaven so you built up a stair
How many bricks till you manufacture air
Height isn't holiness, noise isn't might
A million men wrong, doesn't turn wrong right
Tower unfinished, the orders collide
Can't finish the sentence but you're reaching the sky
Pass me the
What?
Bring up the
Stop
Listen, I said
So much for the master plan
Yahushua, Yahuwah, sovereign over all
Kings become dust and their kingdoms fall
Yahushua, Yahuwah, none can take your throne
All that breezes borrowed, all the glory yours alone
I got a tower too, built it out of needing to be right
Put my name across the door, it kept my sins away from sight
Yahushua, search the chambers, let no hidden idol stay
I won't mock another kingdom while I build mine the same way
Not my greatness, not my throne, let repentance
Raise the things I won't let go
From the plane to the palace, the pattern repeats
Men want worship with the world at their feet
New flags, new faces, same ancient lie
Dust a man in the race of the sky
But the grave doesn't travel at a royal decree
No mortal can purchase eternity
Mercy isn't weakness, judgment isn't blind
The sovereign of all is not ruled by mankind
No, no, no, no, no, no ruled by mankind
Yahushua, Yahushua, Yahushua
Ever lest it came
Break our pride to pieces, you reign over everything
Yahushua, Yahuwah
No rival, no equal
Not the crown, not the power
Not the praise, not the people
Yours the kingdom
Yours the throne
Every knee brought low
All the glory, yours alone
All the glory yours alone
